description: Add a leaderboard board to an EXISTING game (by gameId — get it from list_games). This is how you add boards to a game that already exists; bootstrap_leaderboard only works for brand-new games. sortDir "desc" = high-scores-win, "asc" = lowest-time-wins. Returns the created board including its id.

gameId.description: UUID of the game to add the board to (from list_games)

maxScore.description: Optional upper bound; scores above are rejected

minScore.description: Optional lower bound; scores below are rejected

retentionN.description: Required when retentionPolicy="top_n": how many top scores to retain (1–1,000,000)

retentionPolicy.description: How long scores are kept: all (default), top_n (best N — set retentionN), or rolling_30d

scoreKind.description: Score type: integer (default), duration_ms (time trials), or float

slug.description: URL-safe slug for the board, e.g. "high-scores" (2–42 chars, lowercase + hyphens)

name: create_board
